claims.assertion: Athena says star races discussed helping Earth decades ago, mainly through starseeds incarnating via immersion pods, step-downs, and walk-ins rather than direct intervention.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She describes this as an inside-out effort.

claims.assertion: She says the Federation removed negative extraterrestrials from the wider solar system long ago, leaving their forces concentrated on Earth.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: Athena describes three Mars sectors as human-reptilian SSP, Mantis, and Maitré; a treaty with Mantis and reptilians prevents Maitré’s removal under Federation law.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She calls the situation a legal problem.
